fix_code:
H, W, N = map(int, input().split())

grid = []
for _ in range(H):
    grid.append(["."] * W)

i = 0
j = 0
p = 0
directions = [(-1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1)]

for _ in range(N):
    if grid[i][j] == ".":
        grid[i][j] = "#"
        p = (p + 1) % 4
    elif grid[i][j] == "#":
        grid[i][j] = "."
        p = (p - 1 + 4) % 4

    i = (i + directions[p][0] + H) % H
    j = (j + directions[p][1] + W) % W

for row in grid:
    print("".join(row))
